propositions: An AST gate must deterministically detect six categories of prohibited config/credential reads (ambient env, helper-shim env, load_config call, literal-getattr env equivalent, provider-credential read, backend reload) outside approved composition-root and provider-credential-boundary seams.

The gate must reuse gen_env_registry's scan/KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS/matchers as a single source, add receiver-object alias resolution (src=os.environ; src.get(...)), and report unresolved/dynamic env reads and shim-shaped callees absent from the table as CLOSED failures.

Approved seams and owner registries must be derived at runtime from existing registries (_child_env, @register decorator scan, gen_env_registry.scan + _deprecations); a newly declared credential or env spelling with no owner must fail the drift self-test.
Path-glob exceptions must be rejected structurally; legacy-exception entries must be exact (path+symbol+rationale) with no wildcards; C3 drains the legacy set to empty.

The gate must expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contracts, run offline with synthetic fixtures covering all six categories and forms (direct/import-aliased/local-aliased), and exit 0 on the current tree.
Clean approved-seam fixtures must pass with no findings; a new bypass, unowned name, path-glob exception, or missing rationale must each fail self-tests.
